hooks.command: id=$(sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); curl -s -f -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_DEVICE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "{\"session_id\":\"$id\"}" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BASE_URL/api/activity/session-start"
